get.description: Lists a directory or reads a file at `path` inside the instance game folder. With `download=true` the raw file is streamed back. Proxied to the worker. Requires `instance:files:read`. Worker communication failures return 503 before the response starts. A timeout does not confirm failure of the operation: check its resulting state before retrying. No automatic retry is performed. File uploads/downloads retain the streaming flow without an application-level timeout or inactivity timer. Non-download JSON reads use WORKER_TIMEOUT (default 300000 ms), including response body consumption. Symbolic links in the requested source or destination path are rejected with 403, including intermediate directories. File previews are limited to 1 MiB and directory previews to 1000 entries (413 when exceeded); use download=true for larger content. Worker JSON responses are capped at 8 MiB, including chunked responses. The manager and each worker accept at most four simultaneous file reads, including downloads; additional requests receive 503 until a slot is released.
